leads.claim: The CIA Scientific Advisory Panel reviewed evidence presented by the Air Technical Intelligence Center regarding documented UAP incidents.
leads.why: The text refers to the review of incident reports and intelligence data rather than the physical possession or analysis of UAP material.
leads.quote: The Panel has received the evidence as presented by cognizant intelligence agencies

leads.claim: Scientists from Brookhaven National Laboratories and other institutions served on a CIA advisory panel.
leads.why: The document lists institutional affiliations of panel members without suggesting these laboratories were involved in the custody or analysis of UAP material.
leads.quote: Brookhaven National Laboratories | | /s/ Luis W. Alvarez

doc_verdict: This document contains no evidence of the government or contractors obtaining, holding, or analyzing physical UAP material; it is strictly an administrative report on a scientific advisory panel's review of intelligence data.
